setting: one continuous day around the old town center; clothing and weather stay consistent within the lesson

sentences.english: Early in the morning, I was walking through town with my family.
sentences.japanese: 朝早く、わたしは家族と町を歩いていました。

sentences.english: First, we stopped at the bookstore near the station, and I chose a book to send to my grandmother.
sentences.japanese: まずは駅前の本屋さんに立ち寄って、おばあちゃんに送る本を選びました。

sentences.english: “Next, let's visit grandfather at the hospital,” my mother said.
sentences.japanese: 「次は病院におじいちゃんのお見舞いに行きましょう」と母が言いました。

sentences.english: Grandfather has been a little sick since last month.
sentences.japanese: おじいちゃんは先月から少し体調を崩しています。

sentences.english: In his bed, he smiled gently and welcomed us.
sentences.japanese: ベッドの上で、やさしく微笑んで迎えてくれました。

sentences.english: On the way back, we did some shopping at the supermarket.
sentences.japanese: 帰りに、スーパーで買い物をしました。

sentences.english: Fresh vegetables and fruit were beautifully arranged.
sentences.japanese: 新鮮な野菜や果物が、きれいに並んでいます。

sentences.english: On our way, we passed an old church standing quietly on a small hill.
sentences.japanese: 途中、小さな丘の上に静かに建つ古い教会のそばを通りました。

sentences.english: Next to it, there was an old temple.
Both are important buildings that protect the quiet of our town.
sentences.japanese: どちらも、町の静けさを守ってくれる大切な建物です。

sentences.english: My father stopped at his office for some work.
sentences.japanese: 父は仕事で事務所に立ち寄りました。

sentences.english: My sister and I read books at the large station waiting room.
sentences.japanese: 妹とわたしは、広い駅の待合室で本を読んでいました。

sentences.english: In the evening, we stopped at a farm shop and bought roasted sweet potatoes.
sentences.japanese: 夕方、農家のお店に寄って、焼き芋を買いました。

sentences.english: On the way home, we could see the small lights of a factory in the distance.
sentences.japanese: 家へ帰る道で、遠くの工場の小さな明かりが見えました。
ご覧いただき、ありがとうございました。
